lens: Shared three-area-light rig, orthographic lens at gameplay pitch (~43 deg), ortho scale 3.4 identical across all four directions

north.notes: Poll side of the axe: continuous lofted trunk with no terrace ledges, bark ridges hug the wall, flares and chips grounded, haft and knob fully in frame.

south.notes: Bit side: pale edge strip enters the wood over the split bruise and hairline crack; the former floating rim-notch block is gone — the rim scar now lies flush on the endgrain.

east.notes: Cut marks, growth ring, and rim scar all flush on the top face; trunk facets taper continuously; root flares meet the ground with no gaps.

west.notes: Full axe silhouette in frame after reframing (scale 3.0 to 3.4); split crack pokes believably from under the bit; no intersection artifacts between head, top face, and scars.

defectsFoundAndFixed: Rim notch read as a dark block floating proud of the rim from the south; rebuilt as a flush top-face scar near the rim.
Axe haft/knob clipped by the frame top in the west view; per-object framing widened from ortho 3.0 to 3.4.
